# Telemetry

The daemon writes one JSON log record for each event. This page lists the
attributes of the records. A key is a contract with the queries of the
operator: a key does not change its name.

## tsunderlay attributes

OpenTelemetry semantic conventions do not define these attributes.

| Key | Type | Stability | Description | Examples |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tsunderlay.actions` | any | development | The route commands of the plan, each with its error if it failed. Each element is an object with the field `command` and the optional field `error`. |  |
| `tsunderlay.blocked` | string[] | development | The needed routes that an operator route holds, each with the command that deletes the operator route. | `["192.200.0.0/24 is held by a route that tsunderlay does not own (en0 via 192.168.1.1); delete it: /sbin/route -n delete -ifscope en0 -net 192.200.0.0/24"]` |
| `tsunderlay.control.dns_error` | string | development | The failure to resolve a control host. | `"lookup controlplane.tailscale.com: no such host"` |
| `tsunderlay.control.prefixes` | string | development | The prefixes of the control hosts, separated by a comma and a space. | `"3.33.130.190/32, 15.197.150.20/32"`, `"none"` |
| `tsunderlay.control.urls` | string[] | development | The control server URLs that the daemon keeps reachable. | `["https://controlplane.tailscale.com"]` |
| `tsunderlay.duration_ms` | int | development | The time of the reconcile, in milliseconds. | `12` |
| `tsunderlay.exit_reason` | string | development | The cause of the daemon exit, `signal` or the error that stopped the daemon. | `"signal"` |
| `tsunderlay.lan` | string | development | The physical uplink, as the interface and the gateway. | `"en0 via 192.168.1.1"`, `"none (no global default on a physical interface)"` |
| `tsunderlay.plan.no_effect` | string | development | The route commands of a plan that the last reconcile applied and the table still needs, one on each line. | `"/sbin/route -n add -proto1 -host 3.33.130.190 192.168.1.1"` |
| `tsunderlay.trigger` | enum | development | The cause of the reconcile. |  |
| `tsunderlay.vpn` | string | development | The full-tunnel VPN, as the interface and the gateway of the split default routes. | `"utun5 via 198.18.64.1"`, `"none (no global 0/1 and 128.0/1)"` |

### Values of `tsunderlay.trigger`

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `start` | The daemon started. |
| `route-event` | The kernel sent route messages. |
| `backstop` | The backstop timer ticked. |
| `retry` | The wait that the last reconcile asked for ended. |

## Semantic convention attributes

These attributes come from
[OpenTelemetry semantic conventions 1.43.0](https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions/tree/v1.43.0).

| Key | Type | Stability | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `error.type` | enum | stable | The class of the failure. |
| `service.name` | string | stable | Logical name of the service. |
| `service.version` | string | stable | The version string of the service component. The format is not defined by these conventions. |

### Values of `error.type`

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `rib` | The daemon could not read the routing table. |
| `route` | A route command failed. |
